title: Income Annuities Desk Guide: Payment Method, Deposit Account and Mailing Address
content:
The owner of an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract, or the payee receiving continuing payments, may change the payment method among the tier's payment methods and the deposit account, and may change the mailing address.

**Status condition.** A payment instruction change is accepted only while the contract status is income active, payments suspended, survivor continuing or beneficiary continuing. The status is the one on that contract's own record.

**Bank changes after an address change.** Within the tier's bank change hold period after the most recent address change, a bank account change is accepted only on a signed, signature-verified request. Otherwise a verified caller may change the account by phone. The evidence of a signed, signature-verified request is the bank change service request on file for the contract — its type, status and signed date — read against the date of the last address change on the contract record; a caller's statement that a form was signed is not that record.

**Account holder.** The deposit account must be in the name of the payee.

**When a change takes effect.** A change received at least the tier's payment instruction cutoff in business days before a payment date applies to that payment; a change received later applies from the following payment date.

| Situation | Bank account change accepted |
|---|---|
| Contract status closed to changes (for example completed, death claim pending, declined) | Not accepted |
| Status open; inside the hold period after the most recent address change | Only on a signed, signature-verified request |
| Status open; outside the hold period | By phone from a verified caller |

**Timing illustration (hypothetical, 10-business-day cutoff).** A change received 10 business days before a payment date applies to that payment; a change received 9 business days before it applies from the following payment date.
